Karthik,

Quick note — we're finalizing our FY28 budget and want to:
- move from our current 6‑month term to a 12‑month term (aligning to our procurement cadence)
- add a burst capacity addendum for +150% peak traffic for occasional events
- confirm minimum SLA credits/resolution windows for ded instances

Attached is a draft order form (v3) with the proposed quantities and a short note from procurement. Can you route to legal and billing and let me know if any of this requires an amendment to the MSA? We prefer a single consolidated signature if possible.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20m call today if helpful.

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai; markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2027 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Subscription refresh — capacity bump & term change

Team — reviewed orderform_SKY_v3.pdf and sketched an addendum draft. High-level legal notes (summary):

- Term length: moving to 12 months is fine; we need to ensure auto-renew and notice windows are consistent with our billing cycle (we propose 60 days notice for renewal change).
- Burst capacity: prefer an addendum that defines burst as "temporary scaling above contracted capacity for defined events" with clear limits: max burst multiplier, duration per event, number of burst events per 12‑month period, pricing rate for burst tokens.
- SLA / Credits: current MSA caps credits at 50% of monthly recurring charges (MRC) — Skyline wants stronger remedy. We should offer an exception for Dedicated customers limited to 75% MRC but only if they accept the burst pricing and operational runbook. Need internal approval for increasing credit cap.
- Data retention / audit: Skyline asked about logs and audit access — we need to confirm SOC2 evidence availability and operational logs retention policy; attach SOC2 stub and log retention summary.
- Indemnity & liability: redline proposes to keep existing liability caps; procurement occasionally asks for carveouts for data breaches — we should push back, accept limited carveouts with specific thresholds and insurer confirmation.
- Termination for convenience: procurement prefers 30 days; our standard is 60. Suggest compromise of 45 days for 12‑month deals.

Action items for internal:
- Markus: please draft alternative SLA credit language and flagged redline sample by EOD Monday.
- Monica: confirm burst engineering feasibility (ops runbook, expected latency SLO during events) and provide a short note for the addendum.
- Karthik: please capture procurement's desired burst pricing so we can include numbers in the addendum.

Attaching a short MSA_changes_summary.docx and a draft burst-addendum-draft.docx for review.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick ops update after reviewing Skyline's traffic samples and the proposed +150% burst:

- Feasible with Dedicated pool scaling and short warm-up (~90s) for large KV cache misses.
- Recommend: allow up to 3 burst events per 12‑month period, each up to 6 hours. Above that we activate negotiated on-demand pricing.
- Will need a short runbook appendix: escalation contacts, pre-warm window request (we will require 24h notice for predicted bursts >10K TPS), and monitoring hooks (we expose token-level metrics and a lightweight webhook for incidents).

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 25 Oct 2027 10:07:00 -0700

Laura — see inline suggested language for SLA credits and burst pricing. My proposed SLA credit clause: limited exception for Dedicated customers where credits may be up to 70% of MRC for a single month, but aggregate credits across a 12‑month period still capped at 75% MRC. Also propose tightening notice requirements for invoking credits to prevent misuse (incident verification & RCA needed).

For burst pricing: propose a tiered per-token uplift (e.g., +1.5x standard rate up to 100% overage, +2x above that) with a clear time window charge. I'll add exact figures to the addendum once procurement confirms desired quantities (Karthik).

-Markus
